units.source_text: 听罢，发长彦带着三只狗和大公主，一起走进洞内。

en.t: After hearing this, Hatsunagahiko took the three dogs and the eldest princess and went into the cave with them.

units.source_text: 果不其然，插着银簪的公主，也在掩面悲泣。

en.t: Sure enough, the princess wearing the silver hairpin was also covering her face and weeping in sorrow.
